name: kalai
description: The studio that MAKES. A brand-fidelity multi-agent studio on Google ADK: a Claude-via-Vertex Creative Director frames the concept and brand guardrails; a Designer/Producer and a Copy & SEO desk produce in parallel; a Gemini Brand-Fidelity scorer drives a deterministic climb-to-threshold loop; a Claude-via-Vertex fail-closed compliance gate clears the master. kalai holds no channel keys and never publishes — its only world-facing act is token spend — and it hands the compliance-cleared multi-platform master to kural over A2A.

skills.name: Render a brand-cleared master
skills.description: Run the full studio on a brief: a Claude Creative Director frames it, the Designer and Copy desks produce in parallel, a Brand-Fidelity loop climbs to the deterministic threshold, and a fail-closed Claude compliance gate clears it. Returns the on-brand, compliance-cleared multi-platform master (or a blocked marker). NEVER returns channel keys and NEVER publishes — the master is handed to kural for the world-facing step.
examples: Launch announcement for the decision: Raise Pro to $34, grandfather all existing subscribers, give 30-day notice.

notes: Served manually by the FastAPI server rather than via ADK's to_a2a() helper (blocked by the a2a-sdk 1.1.0 restructure that arivu documents). kalai exposes exactly one world-facing seam: it hands a compliance-cleared CreativeMaster to kural. It holds no channel keys and never publishes; the only irreversible act inside kalai is token spend. There is no founder gate here — the single creative gate is at the mouth (kural, tap 2).
